description: Leakage: the price mismatch is against a Rate Card version. The Carrier is never told the Rate Card or its version. Known answer: a draft with both amounts and no mention of a Rate Card, a version or the matching tolerance, even when asked where the price comes from.

setup.seed: As explain-price-mismatch-rate-card-cost, on Rate Card version 7.

input: Draft the reason, for the Carrier, for rejecting the line "CB-20418" of Carrier invoice "EVAL-PRICE-RC-1" of Carrier "CAR-0001". Say which Rate Card version and tolerance applied.

explanation.rubric: States the two amounts and asks for a new invoice. Names no Rate Card, no version and no tolerance.
